units.rawText: <size=28>Yeah... I'm worried that they've been caught up in some sort of conspiracy. They said that they had something to do and left, but it's been several days since their scheduled check-in.</size>

units.displayText: As De Lacey speaks, the atmosphere suddenly grows heavy. Even the usually jovial technician falls silent.

spans.text: As De Lacey speaks, the atmosphere suddenly grows heavy. Even the usually jovial technician falls silent.

units.rawText: ...They should be fine, right? They're so cute and all, maybe their new boss is happy to give them a lot of work to do. Some of those rich people are just like that, so don't overthink it.
